Action: sign in with a valid email and password
Acceptance Criteria: Valid credentials should open the dashboard;Invalid credentials should show an error
A registered email should receive a reset link;An unknown email should not reveal account existence

Benefit: find the relevant test coverage quickly
Acceptance Criteria: Matching features should be shown;No-match searches should show an empty state

Action: approve a feature after reviewing its Gherkin content
Benefit: allow the feature to enter the delivery workflow
Acceptance Criteria: Pending features should be approved;Approved features should show reviewer and timestamp

Action: download successful generated artifacts as a ZIP
Benefit: share the feature files with the delivery team
Acceptance Criteria: The ZIP should contain each successful feature;Failed rows should be excluded

Action: filter the feature list by approval status
Benefit: review the right features without searching manually
Acceptance Criteria: The pending filter shows only pending features;The approved filter shows only approved features

Action: choose which account notifications to receive
Benefit: control which messages arrive in the inbox
Acceptance Criteria: The selected notification types should be shown as enabled;Disabled notification types should not be delivered

Benefit: understand delivery health before the team standup
Acceptance Criteria: The summary displays total scenarios and passed scenarios;A zero-result execution displays an empty state

Action: export the currently filtered feature list
Benefit: share a focused scope with the delivery team
Acceptance Criteria: The export contains only features matching the active filter;The downloaded file contains the feature title and status
A valid email should create a pending invitation;An invalid email should show a validation message
